Title: After the call
Prompt: Write a follow-up that lists the two points they cared about, from my notes. Ask one question. Do not add a new offer.
Check: The points are from the notes.

Title: No reply
Prompt: Write a short note that refers to the proposal date and asks if it is still a priority. Do not invent urgency.

Title: They asked for a discount
Prompt: Write a reply that says you will look at scope before price. Do not offer a number.

Title: Not now
Prompt: Write a note that accepts the timing and asks what should be true next quarter. Do not push a meeting this week.

Title: Wrong person
Prompt: Write a note that asks who decides and offers a one-page summary they can forward.

Title: Won
Prompt: Write the confirmation of price, start date, and the next action I provide. Do not add terms.
